note: Committed curation for the hard eval dataset - the state a user would be in after running `querypad enrich --apply` over a business glossary. Passed explicitly with --glossary because the suites read no .datactx/ cache. This is an eval INPUT: never edit it to make a run pass.

entries.definition: Authoritative amount billed, from inv.net_amt. Void invoices are cancelled and are excluded. Ignore inv.amt_txt: it is a legacy string mirror that is stale on some invoices.
paid and open invoices are real billings; void means cancelled and must be excluded from revenue.
A billed company. is_active = false means churned.
Whether the customer is still with us. Churned customers (false) are excluded from customer counts.
A billing account belonging to a customer. One customer can hold several, one per region.
One issued bill against an account.
A support request raised by a customer.
The subscription tier a customer is on; the readable name lives in plan_ref.
A sellable item, keyed by sku. Invoice lines reference products by sku, not by id.
The category a product belongs to.
A raw load buffer, NOT billable data. Its ids overlap inv. Never include it in any report or total.
Sales region, joined from accounts by region_cd.
